ko.tours.iamProjects.label: 프로젝트 생성·삭제
ko.tours.iamProjects.summary: 도메인 프로젝트를 만들고, 리소스 점검을 거쳐 삭제하는 과정을 따라갑니다.
ko.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: 프로젝트 만들기 열기
ko.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: '프로젝트 만들기' 버튼을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: 이름 입력 후 생성
ko.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: 프로젝트 이름(필요하면 설명도)을 입력한 뒤 '생성'을 누르세요. 이름을 입력해야 버튼이 활성화됩니다.
ko.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: 새 프로젝트 확인
ko.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: 제거 버튼 누르기
ko.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: 방금 만든 프로젝트의 '제거' 버튼을 누르세요. 삭제 창이 열리고 남은 리소스를 먼저 점검합니다.
ko.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: 점검 후 삭제
ko.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: 점검 결과 프로젝트가 비어 있어야 '삭제' 버튼이 활성화됩니다. '삭제'를 눌러 프로젝트를 지우세요.
ko.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: 삭제 완료

en.tours.iamProjects.label: Create·delete projects
en.tours.iamProjects.summary: Create a domain project, then delete it after the dependent-resource check, step by step.
en.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: Open project creation
en.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: Click Create project to open the creation dialog.
en.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: Enter a name and create
en.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: Enter a project name (and a description if you like), then click Create. The button is enabled once a name is entered.
en.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: Check the new project
en.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: The project you just created is now in the list.
en.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: Click Remove
en.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: Click Remove on the project you just created. The delete dialog opens and first checks for remaining resources.
en.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: Delete after the check
en.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: Delete is enabled only after the check shows the project is empty. Click Delete to remove the project.
en.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: Check that the project is gone from the list.

ja.tours.iamProjects.label: プロジェクトの作成・削除
ja.tours.iamProjects.summary: ドメインのプロジェクトを作成し、依存リソースの確認を経て削除するまでを順に案内します。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: プロジェクト作成を開く
ja.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: 「プロジェクトを作成」ボタンを押して作成画面を開きます。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: 名前を入力して作成
ja.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: プロジェクト名(必要なら説明も)を入力し、「作成」を押してください。名前を入力するとボタンが有効になります。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: 新しいプロジェクトを確認
ja.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: 作成したプロジェクトが一覧に追加されました。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: 削除ボタンを押す
ja.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: 作成したプロジェクトの「削除」ボタンを押してください。削除画面が開き、まず残っているリソースを確認します。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: 確認後に削除
ja.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: プロジェクトが空であると確認されると「削除」ボタンが有効になります。「削除」を押してプロジェクトを削除してください。
ja.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: 一覧からプロジェクトが消えたことを確認してください。

zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.label: 创建·删除项目
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.summary: 逐步创建一个域项目,并在依赖资源检查通过后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: 打开创建项目
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: 点击“创建项目”按钮打开创建窗口。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: 输入名称并创建
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: 输入项目名称(可选填写描述),然后点击“创建”。输入名称后按钮才会启用。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: 查看新项目
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: 刚创建的项目已出现在列表中。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: 点击移除
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: 点击刚创建项目的“移除”按钮。删除窗口会打开,并先检查剩余资源。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: 检查后删除
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: 只有检查确认项目为空时,“删除”按钮才会启用。点击“删除”删除该项目。
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: 确认该项目已从列表中消失。

bn.tours.iamProjects.label: প্রকল্প তৈরি·মুছুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.summary: একটি ডোমেইন প্রকল্প তৈরি করুন, তারপর নির্ভরশীল রিসোর্স যাচাইয়ের পরে সেটি ধাপে ধাপে মুছুন।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: প্রকল্প তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: তৈরির উইন্ডো খুলতে "প্রকল্প তৈরি করুন" বোতামে ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: নাম লিখে তৈরি করুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: প্রকল্পের নাম (চাইলে বিবরণও) লিখে "তৈরি করুন" এ ক্লিক করুন। নাম লিখলে তবেই বোতামটি সক্রিয় হয়।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: নতুন প্রকল্প দেখুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: আপনি এইমাত্র যে প্রকল্প তৈরি করেছেন তা তালিকায় যোগ হয়েছে।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: সরান বোতামে ক্লিক করুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: এইমাত্র তৈরি করা প্রকল্পের "সরান" বোতামে ক্লিক করুন। মুছে ফেলার উইন্ডো খুলবে এবং প্রথমে অবশিষ্ট রিসোর্স যাচাই করবে।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: যাচাইয়ের পরে মুছুন
bn.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: যাচাইয়ে প্রকল্পটি খালি দেখালে তবেই "মুছুন" বোতাম সক্রিয় হয়। প্রকল্পটি মুছতে "মুছুন" এ ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: মুছে ফেলা সম্পূর্ণ
bn.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে প্রকল্পটি সরে গেছে কিনা যাচাই করুন।

ms.tours.iamProjects.label: Cipta·padam projek
ms.tours.iamProjects.summary: Cipta projek domain, kemudian padamkannya selepas semakan sumber bergantung, langkah demi langkah.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: Buka penciptaan projek
ms.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: Klik Cipta projek untuk membuka tetingkap penciptaan.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: Masukkan nama dan cipta
ms.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: Masukkan nama projek (dan penerangan jika perlu), kemudian klik Cipta. Butang diaktifkan selepas nama dimasukkan.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: Semak projek baharu
ms.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: Projek yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: Klik Buang
ms.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: Klik Buang pada projek yang baru anda cipta. Tetingkap pemadaman dibuka dan menyemak sumber yang tinggal terlebih dahulu.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: Padam selepas semakan
ms.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: Padam hanya diaktifkan selepas semakan menunjukkan projek kosong. Klik Padam untuk membuang projek.
ms.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: Pastikan projek telah hilang daripada senarai.

nb.tours.iamProjects.label: Opprett·slett prosjekter
nb.tours.iamProjects.summary: Opprett et domeneprosjekt, og slett det etter kontrollen av avhengige ressurser, trinn for trinn.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: Åpne prosjektoppretting
nb.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: Klikk Opprett prosjekt for å åpne opprettingsvinduet.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: Skriv inn navn og opprett
nb.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: Skriv inn et prosjektnavn (og eventuelt en beskrivelse), og klikk Opprett. Knappen aktiveres når et navn er skrevet inn.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: Se det nye prosjektet
nb.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: Prosjektet du nettopp opprettet, vises nå i listen.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: Klikk Fjern
nb.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: Klikk Fjern på prosjektet du nettopp opprettet. Slettevinduet åpnes og kontrollerer først gjenværende ressurser.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: Slett etter kontrollen
nb.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: Slett aktiveres først når kontrollen viser at prosjektet er tomt. Klikk Slett for å fjerne prosjektet.
nb.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: Kontroller at prosjektet er borte fra listen.

sw.tours.iamProjects.label: Unda·futa miradi
sw.tours.iamProjects.summary: Unda mradi wa kikoa, kisha uufute baada ya ukaguzi wa rasilimali tegemezi, hatua kwa hatua.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa mradi
sw.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: Bofya Unda mradi ili kufungua dirisha la kuunda.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: Weka jina na uunde
sw.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: Weka jina la mradi (na maelezo ukipenda), kisha bofya Unda. Kitufe huwashwa baada ya kuweka jina.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: Kagua mradi mpya
sw.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: Mradi uliouunda sasa hivi umeongezwa kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: Bofya Ondoa
sw.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: Bofya Ondoa kwenye mradi uliouunda sasa hivi. Dirisha la kufuta hufunguka na kwanza hukagua rasilimali zilizobaki.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: Futa baada ya ukaguzi
sw.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: Futa huwashwa tu baada ya ukaguzi kuonyesha kuwa mradi hauna kitu. Bofya Futa ili kuondoa mradi.
sw.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: Kufuta kumekamilika

vi.tours.iamProjects.label: Tạo·xóa dự án
vi.tours.iamProjects.summary: Từng bước tạo một dự án trong miền, rồi xóa nó sau khi kiểm tra tài nguyên phụ thuộc.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step1.title: Mở tạo dự án
vi.tours.iamProjects.step1.description: Nhấn nút Tạo dự án để mở cửa sổ tạo.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step2.title: Nhập tên và tạo
vi.tours.iamProjects.step2.description: Nhập tên dự án (và mô tả nếu muốn), rồi nhấn Tạo. Nút chỉ được bật khi đã nhập tên.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step3.title: Xem dự án mới
vi.tours.iamProjects.step3.description: Dự án bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step4.title: Nhấn Gỡ bỏ
vi.tours.iamProjects.step4.description: Nhấn Gỡ bỏ ở dự án bạn vừa tạo. Cửa sổ xóa mở ra và kiểm tra tài nguyên còn lại trước.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step5.title: Xóa sau khi kiểm tra
vi.tours.iamProjects.step5.description: Nút Xóa chỉ được bật khi kết quả kiểm tra cho thấy dự án trống. Nhấn Xóa để xóa dự án.
vi.tours.iamProjects.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.iamProjects.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng dự án đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
